messages:
marie_support: Heads-up: we're planning a rolling deploy for the inference runtime next Tue 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC. Need a short statuspage + customer email template. Can someone draft?
elaine_comm: I'll sketch a short status message + subject. Do we have the exact service id and impact matrix?
taylan_oncall: Impact is hosted inference (api.redwood.ai) for a subset of customers on pool-3. Expected short tokenization pause, some requests may failover to fallback model variant. No user data migration.
chris_prod: Suggested statuspage body (short):
```
Incident: Scheduled rolling maintenance for inference pool (pool-3)
Start: 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC
Duration: ~90 minutes (rolling across capacity)
Impact: Temporary increased latency and occasional 5xx errors for a subset of requests. Automatic fallback to compatible model variants enabled.
Customer action: No action required. Retry logic recommended for high-throughput jobs.
```
marie_support: Nice. Can you also draft a push/email subject + one-paragraph blurb we can send to customers who opt into maintenance alerts?
elaine_comm: Subject: Scheduled maintenance — brief impact to inference latency (Mar 30)
Body draft: Hello — On Tue, Mar 30 at 02:00 UTC we will perform a rolling upgrade of our inference runtime on a subset of capacity to deploy performance and reliability fixes. You may see increased latency or occasional 5xx errors for requests routed to affected nodes. We have automatic fallbacks in place and no customer action is required. If you rely on strict SLAs, consider pinning to a Dedicated or Private deployment during the window; contact support for assistance. Expected window: ~90 minutes. Regards, Redwood Support
chris_prod: Add a note about version pinning: if customers need absolute stability, recommend pinning to model+runtime: `model:redwood-gpt-1@v1.4.2+runtime:2026-03-15`. Also include link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/pinning
marie_support: Good. We also need the exact statuspage update steps. taylan_oncall, can you paste the CLI/statusbot commands?
taylan_oncall: Statusbot commands: `@statusbot create "Rolling maintenance — inference pool-3" --start "2026-03-30T02:00:00Z" --expected-duration "90m" --impact "partial" --components "api.redwood.ai"`
statusbot: [automated] Incident created: INC-20260330-01 (rolling maintenance). Public page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20260330-01
deploy-bot: rolling deploy started: release/2026.3.30 on pool-3 (batch 1/5)
marie_support: Keep customers informed: initial status at start, update at 30m, and close with notes + rollback info. Add a short FAQ for common Qs (pinning, retries, SLA).
elaine_comm: Draft FAQ snippet: Q: Will my data be affected? A: No. Q: Should I pin? A: Pinning to Dedicated/Private recommended for zero-change SLA. Q: What if we see regression? A: We'll roll back the deploy and notify via status page + email.
chris_prod: Operational note for SRE runbook: If error rate > 3% for 10m, pause rollout and pin remaining capacity to previous runtime: `/deploy rollback --release release/2026.3.30 --pin-version runtime:2026-03-15`
taylan_oncall: I'll be on-call that night. I'll post batch-level updates. If we need to pin, we will coordinate with support to send customer-facing rollback notice.
marie_support: Final ask: can someone confirm wording for the public status updates? Quick draft: "We are performing a scheduled rolling maintenance on a subset of inference capacity. Some customers may experience increased latency or transient errors. We have automatic fallbacks and monitoring in place; we'll update with progress and a post-maintenance report." Approve?
chris_prod: Approved from eng side.
elaine_comm: Approved from comms. I'll queue the email and prepare the statuspage timeline.
marie_support: Thanks — I'll schedule the customer blast and pin the email list for high-SLA customers. Leave any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
